"# Implementation Plan - Integrating Professional Work Experience Component

This plan details the addition of a new, interactive `WorkExperience` component to the React profile page. It replaces the hardcoded mockup experience with Parvathy Mohan's detailed career timeline, featuring collapsible items using Framer Motion animations. We will also refactor the old experience layout to cleanly isolate the Education timeline.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Collapsible Cards**: We will implement an interactive expand/collapse animation for the responsibilities bullet points in each role using Framer Motion. This prevents layout clutter and makes the UI feel dynamic.
> - **Education Separation**: We will extract the education timeline into a separate, clean `Education.jsx` component, keeping page layout sections focused.
> - **Location details**: Each job entry will store and display its location (e.g., "Infopark, Kochi" or "Kadantra, Kochi").

---

## Proposed Changes

### [MODIFY] [resumeData.js](file:///c:/Users/HP/Documents/JavaApps/profile/src/data/resumeData.js)
Update the `experience` array in `resumeData.js` with the real work details:
- ThinkPlan Technologies (2023 - Present)
- Innoventure Software Labs (2021 - 2023)
- Soften Technologies (2018 - 2019)
Ensure each job object includes `role`, `company`, `location`, `years`, and `responsibilities` arrays.

### [NEW] [WorkExperience.jsx](file:///c:/Users/HP/Documents/JavaApps/profile/src/components/WorkExperience.jsx)
A new component displaying the job cards in chronological order. Features:
- Highlights for job title, company, years, and location.
- Interactive toggle button (e.g. Chevron/Info icon) to expand/collapse the responsibilities list.
- Framer Motion animation (`animate={{ height: isOpen ? 'auto' : 0 }}`) for smooth accordion-style animations.
